role: XCTest performance test for DFAAnalyzer.compute on a 30,000-sample synthetic RR series, with the timing wrapper skipped under Thread Sanitizer.
types: AnalysisPerformanceTests: class — XCTestCase measuring DFA runtime

units.does: Returns true when dlsym(RTLD_DEFAULT, "__tsan_init") resolves, i.e. the Thread Sanitizer runtime is linked.
Builds 30,000 RR values cycling 890-910 ms and asserts DFAAnalyzer.compute returns non-nil; outside TSan wraps it in measure(XCTClockMetric).
units.entry: XCTest runner: test method on an XCTestCase subclass

branches.effect: asserts compute non-nil once and returns without measuring; otherwise runs measure{} with the non-nil assertion in each iteration
